note: Garant Bank's tariff schedule for services to individuals (effective 16 February 2026): its account servicing section for an individual's demand deposit in soums charges nothing to open, keep or close the account.

sources.title: Garant Bank, Tariff Schedule for services provided to individuals (effective 16 February 2026)
sources.said: for services provided to individuals (effective from February 16, 2026) ... I. Demand deposits of individuals denominated in national currency ... 1. Account servicing ... Account opening / closing Free
